selection_criterion: largest vertex-count DK parcel on the strongly-lateral superior convexity (|cx|>=30mm, cz>=0) -> lateral surface coverage
largest strict medial-wall-core DK parcel (median |x|<=9mm AND >=40% of vertices within 7mm of midline AND cz>=15mm) -> medial wall coverage
largest vertex-count DK parcel on the inferior temporal surface (cz<=-10mm, cy<=-5mm) -> inferior/temporal coverage
